grammar: 短语动词，碰头；相聚。常用 meet up with sb，或 meet up at/in a place。
collocations: meet up with friends; meet up at the museum; meet up after school
commonMistake: meet up with 后接碰面的人；约定地点时用 at 或 in，如 meet up at the station。

example.english: We will meet up with our guide at the museum gate.
example.chinese: 我们将在博物馆门口和导游碰面。

application.prompt: Mia and Leo plan to see each other at the station. They will ___. (meet up / remove)

grammar: n. 博物馆。可数名词，单数前常用 a 或 the；复数为 museums。
collocations: visit a museum; a history museum; museum ticket
commonMistake: museum 是可数名词；表示去参观博物馆可说 visit a museum。

example.english: Our class visited a small science museum on Friday.
example.chinese: 我们班星期五参观了一家小型科学博物馆。

application.prompt: You can see old objects and paintings in a ___. (museum / factory)

grammar: n. 展览。可数名词，复数 exhibitions；常指在某处展出的作品或物品。
collocations: an art exhibition; hold an exhibition; visit an exhibition
commonMistake: exhibition 是可数名词，单数前要有冠词或其他限定词，如 an exhibition。

example.english: The school exhibition shows pictures of local birds.
example.chinese: 学校的展览展示了本地鸟类的图片。

application.prompt: The library is showing students' paintings this week. It is an art ___. (exhibition / direction)

grammar: n. 方向。常用 in the direction of；问路时常说 directions，表示路线指引。
collocations: in the right direction; ask for directions; follow the directions
commonMistake: 问去某地的路线时常用复数 directions；direction 也可指一个方向。

example.english: The sign points in the direction of the museum.
example.chinese: 标志指向博物馆的方向。

application.prompt: I cannot find the station. I will ask a police officer for ___. (directions / cucumber)

grammar: n. 旅行。可数名词；常指一次短途或有明确目的的行程，复数为 trips。
collocations: a school trip; go on a trip; a trip to the coast
commonMistake: 表示“去某地旅行”常说 go on a trip to + 地点；trip 是可数名词。

example.english: Our school trip to the farm starts at eight.
example.chinese: 我们去农场的学校旅行八点出发。

application.prompt: The class is taking a two-day ___ to the mountains. (trip / germ)

grammar: n. 废水。通常作不可数名词；指家庭、工厂等使用后排出的水。
collocations: treat wastewater; wastewater treatment; clean wastewater
commonMistake: wastewater 通常作不可数名词，不说 a wastewater；可说 wastewater from a factory。

example.english: The plant treats wastewater before it enters the river.
example.chinese: 这家工厂在废水流入河流前对其进行处理。

application.prompt: Used water from homes and factories is called ___. (wastewater / fresh water)

grammar: n. 工厂；也可指植物。本单元语境中指工厂，是可数名词，复数为 plants。
collocations: a paper plant; a water treatment plant; work at a plant
commonMistake: plant 既可指“植物”也可指“工厂”，需根据 wastewater、machines 等上下文判断。

example.english: The plant makes paper from used boxes.
example.chinese: 这家工厂用旧纸箱造纸。

application.prompt: Workers make tools in this large building. It is a ___. (plant / leaf)

grammar: prep. 到……里面；进入。强调从外部向内部移动，后接名词或代词。
collocations: go into a room; put sth into a box; turn into
commonMistake: into 表示进入的动作；in 表示已经在里面，如 walk into the tent / stay in the tent。

example.english: Please put the empty bottles into this basket.
example.chinese: 请把空瓶子放进这个篮子里。

application.prompt: The hikers walked ___ the tent to get out of the rain. (into / along)

grammar: v. 移开；拿走。规则变化 remove—removed—removed；常用 remove sth from a place。
collocations: remove a label; remove rubbish; remove sth from a box
commonMistake: 表示从某处拿走某物用 remove sth from somewhere；remove 后不直接加 away。

example.english: Please remove the plastic cover from the box.
example.chinese: 请把塑料盖从盒子上拿下来。

application.prompt: Take the broken sign away from the path. Please ___ it. (remove / create)

grammar: n. 片；块。可数名词，常用 a piece of + 不可数名词表示一片或一块。
collocations: a piece of paper; a piece of wood; two pieces of advice
commonMistake: piece 本身可数；不可数名词前用 a piece of，复数数量用 pieces of。

example.english: We found a piece of glass beside the road.
example.chinese: 我们在路边发现了一块玻璃。

application.prompt: Cut one small ___ of paper for the model. (piece / process)

grammar: n. 废弃物；v. 浪费。作名词可指不需要的材料；作动词后接被浪费的时间、资源等。
collocations: reduce waste; food waste; waste water; waste time
commonMistake: waste 作动词时不能与 wastewater 混淆；waste time 表示浪费时间，waste 可作名词或动词。

example.english: We reuse old paper so we waste less.
example.chinese: 我们再利用旧纸，因此浪费得更少。

application.prompt: Using a new sheet when the old one is clean can ___ paper. (waste / treat)

grammar: n. 机器。可数名词，复数 machines；常指用电力或其他动力完成工作的设备。
collocations: a washing machine; a machine for cutting paper; operate a machine
commonMistake: machine 是可数名词，单数前通常需有限定词，如 a machine。

example.english: This machine turns old bottles into small pieces.
example.chinese: 这台机器把旧瓶子处理成小块。

application.prompt: A device that helps workers cut wood is a ___. (machine / exhibition)

grammar: n. 微生物；细菌。可数名词，复数 germs；常用于谈论可能引起疾病的微生物。
collocations: kill germs; germs on hands; protect yourself from germs
commonMistake: germ 是可数名词，常用 germs 泛指细菌；洗手可帮助减少手上的 germs。

example.english: Wash your hands to remove germs before lunch.
example.chinese: 午饭前洗手可以去除细菌。

application.prompt: Tiny organisms that may make people ill are called ___. (germs / grains)

grammar: n. 步骤；脚步。可数名词；描述做事方法时常指一个步骤，也可指走路的一步。
collocations: the first step; follow the steps; take a step forward
commonMistake: step 可指“步骤”或“脚步”；制作说明中的 step 通常是一个操作环节。

example.english: The first step is to wash and dry the bottle.
example.chinese: 第一步是把瓶子洗净并晾干。

application.prompt: In a set of instructions, each action is a ___. (step / actor)

grammar: used to + 动词原形，表示过去经常做或过去存在、现在已不同的情况。
collocations: used to walk; used to live; didn't use to; Did ... use to ...?
commonMistake: used to 后接动词原形；否定和疑问句中常用 did，写作 didn't use to / Did you use to ...?。

example.english: This path used to lead to the old factory.
example.chinese: 这条小路过去通向那家旧工厂。

application.prompt: In the past, the mill ___ make paper. (used to / use to)

grammar: v. 认识到；实现。规则变化 realize—realized—realized；英式拼法常见 realise。
collocations: realize a mistake; realize that ...; realize a dream
commonMistake: realize 可表示“意识到”或“实现”；英式英语也常拼作 realise，含义相同。

example.english: I realized that the map was upside down.
example.chinese: 我意识到地图被倒着拿了。

application.prompt: When Sam saw the sign, he understood he was on the wrong road. He ___ his mistake. (realized / removed)

grammar: prep. 在……里面；adv. 在里面。作介词后接地点名词，作副词时可单独使用。
collocations: inside the museum; go inside; the inside of a tent
commonMistake: inside 表示位置“在里面”；into 强调从外面进入的动作，如 wait inside / walk into the room。

example.english: It was cold, so we waited inside the visitor centre.
example.chinese: 天气很冷，所以我们在游客中心里面等候。

application.prompt: The rain has stopped. You can wait ___ the tent until the guide returns. (inside / along)

grammar: 短语，去旅行。go on a trip to + 地点；主语为第三人称单数时 go 变为 goes。
collocations: go on a school trip; go on a trip to the coast; plan a trip
commonMistake: trip 是可数名词，短语中通常说 go on a trip，不能漏掉 a。

example.english: My cousins go on a trip to the lake each summer.
example.chinese: 我的表兄妹每年夏天都去湖边旅行。

application.prompt: Next month the class will ___ to the science museum. (go on a trip / write down)

grammar: n. 过程。可数名词，复数 processes；常指一系列逐步完成的变化或操作。
collocations: the process of recycling; a long process; in the process
commonMistake: process 是可数名词；单数前常用 the/a，复数拼写为 processes。

example.english: The process of making paper takes several steps.
example.chinese: 造纸的过程需要几个步骤。

application.prompt: Making new paper from old paper is a ___. (process / direction)

grammar: n. 戏院；剧场；电影院。可数名词；theater 是常见的美式拼法。
collocations: go to the theatre; a theatre ticket; a theatre performance
commonMistake: theatre 是英式拼法，美式英语常写 theater；两种拼法都表示剧场等场所。

example.english: We saw a play at the theatre near the river.
example.chinese: 我们在河边的剧场看了一场戏。

application.prompt: People sit here to watch a play on stage. It is a ___. (theatre / factory)

grammar: n. 工厂。可数名词，复数 factories；辅音字母 + y 结尾的名词变复数时通常改 y 为 ies。
collocations: a paper factory; work in a factory; factory workers
commonMistake: factory 的复数是 factories，不是 factorys；不要与意为“植物”的 plant 混淆。

example.english: The factory uses less water than before.
example.chinese: 这家工厂比以前用水少了。

application.prompt: The town has two paper ___. (factories / factorys)

grammar: adj. 糟糕的；令人不快的。可修饰 weather、noise、journey 等名词。
collocations: terrible weather; a terrible mistake; feel terrible
commonMistake: terrible 是形容词，修饰名词；副词形式是 terribly，如 terribly cold。

example.english: The road was terrible after the heavy rain.
example.chinese: 大雨过后，这条路状况很糟。

application.prompt: The bus was late and the road was flooded. It was a ___ journey. (terrible / fresh)

grammar: n. 演员。可数名词，复数 actors；actor 可指男演员，也可泛指演员，女性演员也可称 actress。
collocations: a film actor; a famous actor; play an actor
commonMistake: actor 是名词；表示“扮演”时用动词 act，如 act in a play。

example.english: The actor spoke clearly in the school play.
example.chinese: 这位演员在学校话剧中说得很清楚。

application.prompt: The person who performs a role in a play is an ___. (actor / visitor)

grammar: n. 枪。可数名词，复数 guns；本词常出现在故事、历史或安全语境中。
collocations: a toy gun; a water gun; a gun in a display
commonMistake: gun 是可数名词，单数前要有 a/the 等限定词；不要把它与 gum（口香糖）混淆。

example.english: The old toy gun is behind the glass in the museum.
example.chinese: 这把旧玩具枪陈列在博物馆的玻璃柜后。

application.prompt: The museum label says the object is a model ___. (gun / grain)

grammar: 短语动词，试穿。可说 try on a jacket，也可说 try a jacket on；代词宾语放中间。
collocations: try on a coat; try a hat on; try it on
commonMistake: 宾语是代词时放在中间：try it on；不能说 try on it。

example.english: Can I try on this raincoat before the trip?
example.chinese: 旅行前我可以试穿这件雨衣吗？

application.prompt: The jacket may be too large. Please ___ before buying it. (try it on / try on it)

grammar: prep. 沿着；顺着。后接道路、河流、海岸等名词，表示沿某条线移动。
collocations: along the road; walk along the river; trees along the street
commonMistake: along 后接路线名词，如 along the road；表示进入道路则用 onto 或 into，含义不同。

example.english: We walked along the river to the old bridge.
example.chinese: 我们沿着河边走到那座老桥。

application.prompt: Follow the path beside the river. Walk ___ the river to the bridge. (along / inside)

grammar: n. 道路。可数名词，复数 roads；常和 on、along、across 等介词连用。
collocations: along the road; cross the road; a busy road
commonMistake: road 指供车辆或行人通行的道路；常说 on the road，沿着道路说 along the road。

example.english: A new bike path runs beside the main road.
example.chinese: 一条新的自行车道沿着主干道旁边延伸。

application.prompt: Cars and buses travel on this way between towns. It is a ___. (road / basket)

grammar: v. 创造；创作。规则变化 create—created—created；名词形式 creation。
collocations: create a model; create a design; create a new place
commonMistake: create 的过去式和过去分词均为 created；不要漏掉词尾的 e 后再多写一个 e。

example.english: The students created a map of the nature park.
example.chinese: 学生们绘制了一张自然公园地图。

application.prompt: The club wants to ___ a poster for its trip. (create / remove)

grammar: v. 记录；n. 记录。作动词可说 record information；作名词常说 keep a record of sth。
collocations: record a trip; keep a record; a school record
commonMistake: record 既可作动词也可作名词，句中位置可帮助判断词性；动词 record sth，名词 a record。

example.english: I recorded the bird names in my notebook.
example.chinese: 我把鸟的名称记录在笔记本里。

application.prompt: To remember what happened, Maya will ___ the trip in her diary. (record / explore)

grammar: n. 技能。可数名词，复数 skills；常指通过学习或练习获得的能力。
collocations: learn a skill; develop a skill; communication skills
commonMistake: skill 是可数名词，单数前通常用 a；形容词 skilled 表示“熟练的”。

example.english: Making a paper basket is a useful skill.
example.chinese: 制作纸篮是一项有用的技能。

application.prompt: After practising for weeks, Leo learned a new cooking ___. (skill / wastewater)

grammar: 短语动词，写下；记下。可说 write down a name，也可说 write a name down；代词宾语放中间。
collocations: write down an address; write down the steps; write it down
commonMistake: 宾语是代词时必须放在 write 与 down 之间，如 write it down。

example.english: Write down the bus number before we leave.
example.chinese: 我们出发前把公交车号码记下来。

application.prompt: I may forget the meeting time, so I will ___. (write it down / write down it)

grammar: v. 探索；考察。规则变化 explore—explored—explored；后接地点或事物作宾语。
collocations: explore a cave; explore the countryside; explore an idea
commonMistake: explore 后可直接接地点，不需要加介词 in，如 explore the forest。

example.english: The group explored the forest with a local guide.
example.chinese: 小组在当地向导带领下探索了森林。

application.prompt: On the nature walk, the students will ___ the old woodland. (explore / fill)

grammar: n. 帐篷。可数名词，复数 tents；可用 put up a tent 表示搭帐篷。
collocations: put up a tent; sleep in a tent; a camping tent
commonMistake: tent 是可数名词；表示搭起帐篷常说 put up a tent，不能按字面说 build a tent。

example.english: We put up the tent before the sun went down.
example.chinese: 太阳下山前我们搭好了帐篷。

application.prompt: Campers sleep in this portable shelter. It is a ___. (tent / machine)

grammar: n. 黄瓜。可数名词，复数 cucumbers；常作蔬菜食用。
collocations: a cucumber salad; slice a cucumber; fresh cucumbers
commonMistake: cucumber 是可数名词，复数直接加 s：cucumbers。

example.english: We picked a cucumber from the garden for lunch.
example.chinese: 我们从菜园摘了一根黄瓜当午餐。

application.prompt: This long green vegetable is often sliced for salad. It is a ___. (cucumber / grain)

grammar: 短语结构，从……到……。from 和 to 分别引出起点与终点，可用于地点、时间或数字范围。
collocations: from Monday to Friday; from the station to the museum; from 8 to 10
commonMistake: 表示起点到终点时 from 与 to 配对使用；不要把 from 和 for 混用。

example.english: The museum is open from Tuesday to Sunday.
example.chinese: 博物馆从星期二开放到星期日。

application.prompt: Choose the pair showing the starting and ending points: ___ Monday ___ Friday. (from, to / into, along)

grammar: adv. 笔直地；立即；adj. 直的。常用 go straight ahead 指一直向前走。
collocations: go straight ahead; a straight road; straight after school
commonMistake: straight 作副词时形式不变，不加 -ly；straight ahead 表示径直向前。

example.english: Go straight ahead, and the theatre will be on your left.
example.chinese: 一直往前走，剧场就在你的左边。

application.prompt: At the next crossing, do not turn; continue ___. (straight ahead / inside)

grammar: v. 装满；盛满。常用 fill sth with sth；也可用 fill a basket with leaves。
collocations: fill a bottle with water; fill a basket; fill in a form
commonMistake: 表示用某物装满容器说 fill the basket with apples；容器作主语时可说 the basket is full of apples。

example.english: She filled the basket with fresh leaves.
example.chinese: 她把新鲜的叶子装进篮子里。

application.prompt: Use water to make the bottle full. You ___ the bottle ___ water. (fill ... with / remove ... from)

grammar: n. 篮子；筐。可数名词，复数 baskets；常用 a basket of + 复数名词或不可数名词。
collocations: a basket of apples; a picnic basket; put sth in a basket
commonMistake: basket 是可数名词，单数前通常要有 a/the；篮子里装什么可用 a basket of ... 表达。

example.english: The children carried a basket of apples to the picnic.
example.chinese: 孩子们带了一篮苹果去野餐。

application.prompt: You can carry vegetables in a ___. (basket / theatre)

grammar: v. 教。teach—taught—taught；常用 teach sb sth 或 teach sb to do sth。
collocations: teach English; teach a skill; teach sb to make a model
commonMistake: teach 的过去式和过去分词是 taught，不是 teached；常说 teach someone how to do sth。

example.english: Mr Lee taught us how to make a paper boat.
example.chinese: 李老师教我们如何制作纸船。

application.prompt: Last week, Aunt May ___ me to plant seeds. (taught / teach)

grammar: n. 树枝；分支。可数名词，复数 branches；在植物语境指树枝，在机构或学科语境指分支。
collocations: a tree branch; a branch of a bank; a branch of science
commonMistake: branch 的复数是 branches；本课自然语境中通常指树枝。

example.english: A small bird sat on a branch above the path.
example.chinese: 一只小鸟停在小路上方的树枝上。

application.prompt: A part that grows from the trunk of a tree is a ___. (branch / basket)

grammar: n. 叶；叶子。可数名词，复数为 leaves；通常把 f 变为 v 再加 -es。
collocations: a green leaf; fall leaves; a leaf of paper
commonMistake: leaf 的复数是 leaves，不是 leafs；类似变化还有 knife—knives。

example.english: One yellow leaf fell onto my notebook.
example.chinese: 一片黄叶落在我的笔记本上。

application.prompt: In autumn, the tree loses many ___. (leaves / leafs)

grammar: adv. 终于；最后。可用于叙述一连串步骤的最后一步，也可表示等待后终于发生。
collocations: finally arrive; finally finish; first ... next ... finally ...
commonMistake: finally 常用于最后完成或等待后发生的事；句首使用时后面通常加逗号。

example.english: After an hour, we finally reached the lake.
example.chinese: 一个小时后，我们终于到达了湖边。

application.prompt: We washed the jars, dried them, and ___ put them away. (finally / inside)

grammar: 短语动词，考虑；想起。常用 think of an idea/person；think of 后接名词或动名词。
collocations: think of a plan; think of someone; think of doing sth
commonMistake: think of 可表示想到或考虑；后接动作时常用动词-ing，如 think of visiting the museum。

example.english: Can you think of a name for our recycling project?
example.chinese: 你能为我们的回收项目想个名字吗？

application.prompt: We need a new idea for the poster. Can you ___ one? (think of / go into)

grammar: n. 谷物；谷粒。通常作可数名词，指谷物种子或一粒粒的颗粒；复数 grains。
collocations: a grain of rice; grains of sand; whole grains
commonMistake: grain 可指谷物作物或单个颗粒；表示一粒米时说 a grain of rice。

example.english: A single grain of rice was left in the bowl.
example.chinese: 碗里还剩下一粒米。

application.prompt: The smallest single piece of rice is a grain of ___. (rice / branch)

grammar: adj. 新鲜的；也可表示新近的。常修饰 food、fruit、air 等名词。
collocations: fresh fruit; fresh air; fresh vegetables
commonMistake: fresh 是形容词，修饰名词时直接放在名词前，如 fresh cucumber；副词形式为 freshly。

example.english: We bought fresh vegetables at the farm shop.
example.chinese: 我们在农场商店买了新鲜蔬菜。

application.prompt: These cucumbers were picked this morning, so they are ___. (fresh / terrible)

grammar: adv. 肯定地；当然。可用于表示确定或礼貌答应，常放在动词前或独立作答。
collocations: certainly true; certainly help; Certainly!
commonMistake: certainly 是副词；形容词是 certain。表示“当然”也可以单独说 Certainly!。

example.english: Certainly, I can show you the way to the museum.
example.chinese: 当然，我可以给你指去博物馆的路。

application.prompt: “Can you help us carry the baskets?” “___!” (Certainly / Terrible)

grammar: n. 日记；日记本。可数名词，复数 diaries；记录日常经历可说 keep/write a diary。
collocations: write in a diary; keep a diary; a diary entry
commonMistake: diary 的复数是 diaries，辅音字母 + y 结尾变复数时 y 改为 ies。

example.english: I write a short note in my diary every night.
example.chinese: 我每天晚上在日记里写一则简短记录。

application.prompt: Ella writes about her day in a ___. (diary / machine)

grammar: n. （日记的）一则；入口。可数名词，复数 entries；含义按 diary、door 等上下文判断。
collocations: a diary entry; write an entry; the main entry
commonMistake: entry 的复数是 entries；在 diary entry 中表示日记的一则，不是“入口”。

example.english: My first diary entry is about our visit to the museum.
example.chinese: 我的第一则日记写的是我们参观博物馆的经历。

application.prompt: A dated note in a diary is a diary ___. (entry / germ)

grammar: v. 赞成；同意。agree with sb/an opinion；agree to a plan/request；agree on a date。
collocations: agree with a person; agree to a plan; agree on a time
commonMistake: agree with + 人/观点；agree to + 计划或建议；agree on + 双方商定的具体事项。

example.english: We agreed to meet at the station at nine.
example.chinese: 我们同意九点在车站碰面。

application.prompt: Both students say the clean-up should start at 9:00. They ___ on the time. (agree / remove)

grammar: 短语，赞成；同意。agree with 后接人或观点；第三人称单数为 agrees with。
collocations: agree with me; agree with an idea; don't agree with
commonMistake: 表示赞成某人的看法用 agree with；不说 agree to a person。

example.english: I agree with Nina that we should reuse the jars.
example.chinese: 我赞同妮娜的看法，我们应该重复利用这些罐子。

application.prompt: Tom thinks the path should stay clean, and I have the same opinion. I ___ Tom. (agree with / agree on)
